## [How the money flows]{.en}[资金流向]{.zh}

::: {.en}
**Utilities buy meters by tender; the distributor, installer and data platform are each paid separately.**

-   A retail water utility tenders for meters and pays about A\$135 per DN20 smart meter, meter only \[27\].
-   On the distributor route, the distributor takes about 15% of the price and runs local verification and warehousing, as Avnet does for Huizhong with its Melbourne test lab \[10, 27\].
-   The manufacturer is paid an ex-works price and bears sea freight to Australia (under A\$1 a meter) and warranty \[27\].
-   Installation and the data platform (for example Iota's Lentic) are bought separately by the utility \[67\].

::: {.placeholder}
- Diagram: who pays whom
:::
:::

::: {.zh}
**水务公司通过招标采购水表；代理商、安装方和数据平台分别收费。**

-   零售水务公司对水表进行招标，每只DN20智能水表（仅表具）约支付135澳元 \[27\]。
-   在代理模式下，代理商约获得售价的15%，并负责本地检定和仓储，例如Avnet利用其墨尔本检测实验室为汇中提供服务 \[10, 27\]。
-   生产商获得出厂价，承担运往澳洲的海运费（每只不到1澳元）和质保 \[27\]。
-   安装和数据平台（如Iota的Lentic）由水务公司另行采购 \[67\]。

::: {.placeholder}
- 示意图：谁向谁付费
:::
:::

## [Major players]{.en}[主要参与方]{.zh}

::: {.en}
Three Chinese makers already hold NMI approval or a major contract: Huizhong through Avnet at South East Water, Sanchuan and Ningbo Water Meter. Landis+Gyr and Sagemcom supply the other metro programs, and Iota runs the Lentic data platform. Details and sources are in [Report 5.2](../report/competitors.qmd).
:::

::: {.zh}
三家中国厂商已取得NMI批准或大型合同：汇中经Avnet供货东南水务，以及三川和宁波水表。Landis+Gyr和Sagemcom为其他大都市项目供货，Iota运营Lentic数据平台。详情及来源见[报告5.2](../report/competitors.qmd)。
:::

| Ex-works price (DN20 NB-IoT, Australian spec) | RMB 400 | RMB 250–650 | Assumption; CDEG to replace |
| Exchange rate | RMB 4.7 per A\$ | 4.2–5.2 | Check on the day |

| Local verification and QA | A\$3 a meter | A\$1–6 | Estimate |
| Warranty provision | 3% of price | 1–6% | Assumption |
| Distributor margin | 15% of price | 8–25% | Estimate |

| WaterMark and AS/NZS 4020, first year | A\$25,000 | A\$10,000–40,000 | Industry estimate |
| Product adaptation for Australia | A\$150,000 | A\$0–400,000 | Assumption |
| Annual overhead: distributor route / own office | A\$200,000 / A\$650,000 | A\$100,000–1m | Assumption |

## [What it means for CDEG]{.en}[对成都环境集团的意义]{.zh}

::: {.en}
**Meters are a near-term but crowded line: a small profit on its own, worth doing for the utility relationships it builds.** The market is about one million meters a year, half of it open before 2032 (Report 3.2). With NMI approval about mid-2028, the base case reaches about 43,000 meters and an EBIT of about A\$0.74m by year 5 \[27\]. The best entry is through a distributor with a test lab, starting with a non-billing pilot at a regional water corporation before its September 2027 price submission, and selling drainage sensors and leak analytics alongside the meter (Report 6.2).
:::

::: {.zh}
**水表是近期可启动但竞争激烈的业务：单独来看利润不大，但值得做，因为它能建立与水务公司的关系。** 市场每年约100万只水表，2032年前约一半开放（报告3.2）。若约2028年中取得NMI批准，基准情景下到第5年销量约4.3万只，息税前利润约74万澳元 \[27\]。最佳进入方式是通过拥有检测实验室的代理商，先在区域水务公司2027年9月价格申报前开展非计费试点，并将排水传感器和漏损分析与水表一起销售（报告6.2）。
:::
